decision.title: Adopt structured logging with pino across all Node services
decision.author: Carol
decision.summary: Short statement that fits easily inside the full budget with room to spare.

ai.rationale: This rationale is deliberately long so the elision path is exercised end to end. Structured logging with pino was chosen over console.log because it produces machine-parseable output, supports log levels consistently across services, and integrates with the existing OpenTelemetry pipeline without a second transport. The team evaluated winston as an alternative and found its default formatting harder to make consistent across services with different owners. Repeating padding to push this comfortably past six thousand characters so the truncation boundary is genuinely exercised rather than landing by coincidence near the cap.
